original_plan.evidence_status: Proposed specification and author-reported pilot targets; not independently reproduced by this audit.

method: Focused primary-source methodological checks and algebraic inspection of the supplied specification; not a systematic literature review.

sources.title: Early warning signals and the prosecutor's fallacy
sources.access: Author abstract inspected; no claim of full-paper replication.
supports: Conditional selection of transition cases can inflate false-positive early-warning patterns.
sources.limits: The ecological simulation does not establish validity of the proposed UK AR(2) design.

sources.title: Methods for Detecting Early Warnings of Critical Transitions in Time Series Illustrated Using Simulated Ecological Data
sources.access: Publisher full text, Step 5 Significance Testing and Discussion, inspected.
supports: Interpretation of surrogate significance depends on the chosen model.
False alarms, missed signals and system characteristics limit early-warning interpretation.
sources.limits: No claim that this study validates H1 or that its particular method is adopted.

sources.title: Equivalence Tests: A Practical Primer for t Tests, Correlations, and Meta-Analyses
sources.access: Institutional full-text PDF inspected, opening rationale and equivalence-bounds discussion.
supports: Non-significance does not establish absence of a meaningful effect.
Exclusion or equivalence claims require a defined effect threshold and appropriate inference.
sources.limits: The t-test and correlation procedures are not adopted for selected, dependent recession episodes; the audit's target-mismatch diagnosis is its own analysis.

sources.authors: Berger, R. L.; Boos, D. D.
sources.title: P Values Maximized Over a Confidence Set for the Nuisance Parameter
sources.access: Publisher abstract available in search output; subsequent direct open failed. Full paper not inspected.
supports: Nuisance-parameter testing can use maximization over parameter space or restriction to a confidence set.
sources.limits: Does not prove an AR(2) least-favourable projection or validate the proposed bootstrap. No uninspected theorem is being applied.

sources.authors: Morris, T. P.; White, I. R.; Crowther, M. J.
sources.title: Using simulation studies to evaluate statistical methods
sources.access: Publisher full text inspected, sections 3–5 and reporting recommendations. PMC direct opening returned a challenge; publisher version supplied the full text.
supports: ADEMP specification separates aims, generating mechanisms, targets, methods and performance.
Simulation performance estimates have Monte Carlo uncertainty.
Verification under limited settings is distinct from robustness investigation.
sources.limits: The AR(2)-specific checklist and independent-finalist-validation proposal are audit recommendations, not claims that this article prescribes those exact choices.

sources.authors: Giacomini, R.; Politis, D. N.; White, H.
sources.title: A Warp-Speed Method for Conducting Monte Carlo Experiments Involving Bootstrap Estimators
sources.access: Publisher abstract and bibliographic record inspected; detailed theorem and algorithm audit remains pending.
supports: Warp-speed Monte Carlo procedures have formal results under conditions.
sources.limits: No claim of general applicability to the proposed C3 bootstrap. Exact construction and conditions must be inspected before implementation.

sources.title: Gross domestic product (GDP) QMI
sources.access: Methodology-only search result supplied full text including timeliness and dissemination; last revised date shown as 8 April 2022.
supports: Reference period and publication date differ.
The methodology describes first quarterly estimates around six weeks after the reference quarter.
sources.limits: Does not verify each historical vintage release date; no dataset download or values are needed for the timing inference.

derivations.basis: PDF page 14 asymptotic covariance statement, delta-method statement and definitions of D and G
derivations.execution: Algebraic derivation only; no new C3 simulation.

derivations.topic: Possible overlap of episode estimation windows
derivations.basis: PDF page 11 specifies 40-quarter windows and an 8-quarter episode-merging threshold
derivations.execution: Logical implication of window support; no inspection of actual episode dates.

data_exposure.description: A search intended to locate ONS publication-timing methodology returned unsolicited GDP landing-page and recent-news snippets containing post-2019 GDP headlines. Later targeted metadata searching also returned post-2019 context in unrelated snippets. These results were not deliberately opened as data sources. No primary-sample series was obtained or analysed, and snippet values were not used to choose the design.
data_exposure.action: Retain this access record and distinguish incidental headline exposure from access to the research series. Use direct methodology URLs and metadata-only retrieval before registration.

prior_data_declaration.basis: Explicit declaration; preparation-stage literature and headline exposure are recorded separately above.
